bug_semantics: PodProbeMarker TCPSocket probes (and later HTTPGet on master) accept an unrestricted Host. kruise-daemon runs with hostNetwork=true, so the daemon dials that Host from the node network namespace and writes probe success/failure plus dial errors into NodePodProbe status. A principal who can create PodProbeMarker objects can therefore SSRF node-local/cloud-metadata/internal addresses and distinguish open vs closed ports.
flaw_origin: The 2022 PodProbeMarker webhook forbade TCP/HTTP handlers. PR #1474 first enabled TCP probes: pkg/daemon/podprobe/prober.go uses p.TCPSocket.Host (fallback podIP) as the dial target, and validateTCPSocketAction only checks Port. Webhook tests treated Host "3.3.3.3" as valid. That omission, on top of pre-existing hostNetwork=true, is the SSRF mechanism. HTTPGet later repeated the missing Host check on master (#2003); the GHSA-reproduced path is TCP.
